authorization: User selected: Fix the remaining CI failures. The offered scope authorized four new sealed repair tasks, hosted-gate verification, corrected main publication, and affected installation refresh.

areas.goal: Write atomically when descriptor chmod is unavailable and close the temporary descriptor before failure cleanup.
areas.observations: Windows Python 3.11 and 3.12 lack os.fchmod; permission failure occurs before descriptor ownership enters a context and cleanup can mask it with WinError 32.

areas.goal: Create and read deterministic ZIP bytes through one owned temporary stream without reopening its live pathname.
areas.observations: All Windows matrix versions fail when deterministic_zip reopens a still-open NamedTemporaryFile by pathname. Existing export, archive/restore, and CLI scenarios already expose the defect.

areas.goal: Preserve the repository operating import in the officially supported .claude/CLAUDE.md location while keeping strict native plugin validation enabled.
areas.observations: Current strict Claude validation warns that root CLAUDE.md is not loaded as plugin context. The file contains only @OPERATING.md. Official memory documentation supports .claude/CLAUDE.md and resolves imports relative to that file.

areas.goal: Verify identical canonical input and each independently rendered audio artifact rather than require byte-identical output from separate operating-system speech generations.
areas.observations: Hosted exports share source_script_sha256 9e79a2c9adfd7219dac392d54cf55a486f6f516b22a11ad4053b6df86e547d91 but measure 47.449887 and 47.473107 seconds. docs/delivery.md limits deterministic byte rendering to core ZIP members. Eight controlled local speech generations and three fixed-input encodes were identical; the hosted variation is retained rather than attributed to an unproven internal cause.

local_audio_evidence.claim: Observed local repeatability does not establish hosted-native byte identity.

controlled_audio_reproduction.controlled_change: Append 512 silent samples to the second real speech generation using FFmpeg.
controlled_audio_reproduction.old_gate_error: repeated canonical audio rendering was not byte-identical
controlled_audio_reproduction.meaning: Different valid native media is a counterexample to the unsupported independent-generation byte invariant.
